name: Grand Plaza Hotel
description: A 4-star hotel with 120 rooms including standard, deluxe, executive, and presidential suites. Located in the heart of the city with easy access to business districts and tourist attractions.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. After that, 1 night charge applies.
policies.smoking: Non-smoking rooms available. Smoking rooms on request.
policies.extraBed: Extra bed available at PKR 3,000 per night.
policies.breakfast: Complimentary breakfast included with Executive and Family rooms.
